title: CNMD - DrainageNetwork schema
description: A drainage network for wastewater and sanitation infrastructure, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be DrainageNetwork.

beginLifespanVersion.description: Property. Beginning of the real-world version. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

boundingBox.description: GeoProperty. GeoJSON geometry delimiting the drainage network coverage area.

concessionaire.description: Relationship. Concessionaire of the drainage network.

connectedTo.description: Relationship. Other drainage networks connected to this network.

criticalInfrastructure.description: Property. Whether the drainage network is critical infrastructure. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

datasetResponsibleParty.description: Property. Party responsible for the dataset. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

dischargesTo.description: Relationship. Location or entity to which the drainage network discharges.

endLifespanVersion.description: Property. End of the real-world version. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

image.description: Property. Images of the drainage network. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

lastInspectionDate.description: Property. Date of the last drainage network inspection. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

license.description: Property. License associated with the data. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for maintaining the drainage network.

maintenanceSchedule.description: Property. Frequency of drainage network maintenance. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

networkType.description: Property. Types of drainage handled by the network. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

quality.description: Property. Observed network quality, from 1 to 5, where 5 is excellent. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

refSubNetworks.description: Relationship. Subnetworks connected within the drainage network's location.

serviceCategory.description: Property. Service categories covered by the drainage network. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

status.description: Property. Operational status of the drainage network. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency with which the data is updated. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

version.description: Property. Version of the data model. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.
